description: An adopted hypothesis that nothing in the bundle serves — discovery debt and build debt in one row.
specRow: S9.4 NEED-COVERAGE-001 fires on an adopted Need with zero citations of either kind.

needsDocument.title: Benefits assistance -- who this is for and why

statement.who: anyone applying from a place with unreliable internet
statement.want: the application to keep working when my connection drops
statement.why: the people who need this help most often have the worst connections
statement.done: a dropped connection never costs me my answers

note: Design-choice record. The unit declares needRefs: [] rather than omitting the key. S9.2's justified predicate requires 'at least one entry', so an empty array is exactly as unjustified as an absent key and NEED-COVERAGE-002 fires alongside. The case pins that reading.
